decision: Alpha Vantage remains primary when the exact observation is nonmissing and concept-qualified. SEC/issuer original disclosures are preferred for key missing concepts and accounting verification; yfinance supplies quick candidates and a bounded pilot cross-check.

scope.provider_extra_history: Preserve received source evidence privately; exclude nonselected periods from the pilot candidate table and report their exclusion. Do not interpret a provider's wider response as scope expansion.

issuers.period_evidence_locator: 2025 Form 10-K inline-XBRL duration contexts and fiscal-year accounting policy; both selected fiscal years span 52 weeks.

preferred_filing_version.selection_reason: Single FY2025 filing version reporting both target years; verify each financial context and any restatement before accepting values.

issuers.period_evidence_locator: Issuer FAQ states July 1 through June 30; 2025 annual consolidated statements identify years ended June 30, 2025 and 2024.

preferred_filing_version.selection_reason: Single FY2025 filing version reporting both target years; verify each financial context and any restatement before accepting values.

issuers.period_evidence_locator: 2025 10-K fiscal-year end and 2026 issuer proxy inline-XBRL annual contexts for 2024/2025; proxy compensation contexts establish calendar evidence only, not financial-fact scope.

preferred_filing_version.selection_reason: Single FY2025 filing version reporting both target years; verify each financial context and any restatement before accepting values.

required_financial_exhibit.requirement: Capture the annual financial report incorporated into the 10-K. The primary document alone is not sufficient financial-statement evidence.

alpha_vantage.primary_qualification: Retain AV only when the selected value is nonmissing and the evidence establishes the intended concept, exact period, units, currency and scope. A finite number or familiar field name alone is insufficient.

yfinance.preserve_raw_response_requirement: Capture original response bytes and request/response receipts through an engineering-owned transport boundary in addition to the returned table; a DataFrame alone is not sufficient provenance. Redact credentials, cookies and tokens from public artifacts.
yfinance.failure_policy: Record absence, empty returns, throttling and transport failures. No symbol substitution, automatic provider switch or unbounded retry.

original_filings.version_policy: Prefer a single documented annual-filing version that reports both target years when compatible; preserve any additionally consulted version and explain restatements. Never mix versions silently.
original_filings.aggregate_xbrl_limit: Companyfacts or frames are discovery aids; verify exact accession/context and original notes when taxonomy, dimensions or classification do not establish the target.
original_filings.sec_contact_configuration: Use an existing authorized SEC identification/contact configuration. Do not invent a contact or print credentials; if unavailable, report the precise prerequisite and use an already authorized issuer-hosted original report where suitable.

includes: authentication or metadata requests initiated by the library
retries and redirects issuing another request
network_budget.engineering_preflight: Declare a per-source request plan within this ceiling and instrument actual wire requests before collection. If request interception or raw-response capture cannot be implemented, report the blocker rather than claiming a complete collection receipt.
network_budget.limit_behavior: Stop before exceeding the ceiling; report partial evidence and remaining gaps. Do not buy a subscription, rotate credentials or enlarge scope.
network_budget.stricter_existing_limit: Use the lower of this ceiling and any already established engineering per-session/per-source request bound; this contract does not enlarge an existing budget.

pure_depreciation_policy.acceptance: Require evidence of annual tangible depreciation expense with matching reporting scope. Cash-flow presentation alone does not establish income-statement expense equivalence. No D&A/DD&A substitution or depletion inclusion.

paper_dp_minus_am_target.acceptance: Collect components separately. Establish income-statement basis, component inclusion and vendor-to-filing scope before any subtraction. Never treat CF D&A minus an arbitrary amortization field as a recovered paper target; no calculation is authorized here.

noncurrent_debt_and_lease_scope.acceptance: Distinguish current/noncurrent, finance/capital versus operating leases and gross/net carrying bases. Require nonoverlap before adding lease components and identical inclusion before total-minus-current reasoning. Broad currentDebt is not current maturities of long-term debt.

ib18_income_bridge.acceptance: Verify tax, NCI attribution, discontinued/extraordinary items, special items and before-dividend basis using the filing. Preserve the CFO scope separately. Neither equality with another field nor an absent discontinued/extraordinary row proves the bridge.

receivables_scope_check.acceptance: Trade/current/net scope must be demonstrated; no name-only acceptance of total receivables or a stock allowance as an expense.

observation_receipt_required: public issuer CIK and exact provider symbol mapping with evidence
provider and original field/tag spelling, statement family and proposed target concept
source URL or request, response status, capture time, raw-content digest and immutable private snapshot pin
code commit, exact library version and source/configuration fingerprints
source-reported period label, explicit flow start/end or instant date, fiscal-year label and annual versus TTM status
currency, displayed unit and scale, source numeric representation and documented scaling operation if any
consolidated/parent/segment scope, NCI attribution, tax/dividend and continuing/discontinued scope where relevant
filing accession, form, filed date, source publication/revision version, source location and XBRL context/dimensions when available
missingness status, conflict status, semantic evidence and named reviewer decision kept separate from engineering integrity checks

alignment_and_conflicts.issuer: Exact verified legal issuer mapping; ticker similarity is insufficient.
alignment_and_conflicts.periods: Require exact stated start/end for flows and exact end date for stocks. No nearest-date, same-month, calendar-month-end or previous-row bridge. A Yahoo month-end label that differs from the issuer date remains an unmatched candidate until an explicit, separately reviewed provider-label explanation is recorded; it is not accepted by this contract.
alignment_and_conflicts.duration: Do not invent starts from a year label, assume four quarters equal an annual flow, or infer a start from the previous end. Calendar evidence is a planned selector, not a provider fact's duration certificate.
alignment_and_conflicts.units_and_currency: No guessed currency/scale, FX conversion or split adjustment. A documented deterministic scale conversion must retain the original amount and unit; unknowns stay unverified.
alignment_and_conflicts.versions: Retain original and restated observations separately; select a coherent documented version, never an implicit latest or a value-by-value mixture.
alignment_and_conflicts.priority: Qualified nonmissing AV has priority. An AV semantic failure is an explicit qualification gap, not permission to accept any nonmissing supplement. Do not overwrite the raw AV observation.
alignment_and_conflicts.disagreement: Preserve both candidates and reconcile using original filing evidence. Do not average, choose the nearest number, or resolve by majority/provider precedence alone.
alignment_and_conflicts.numeric_agreement: Exact equality is an arithmetic diagnostic, not semantic proof. Preserve source display precision/decimals and exact scaled residuals as diagnostics. This pilot permits no rounding tolerance to match or accept a candidate; any later bounded rounding-acceptance rule requires separate technical review and cannot waive concept, scope or date differences.
alignment_and_conflicts.missingness: Preserve missing, absent field, explicit source zero, nonfinite, boolean and invalid numeric states separately. No blind fill, adjacent-period carry, assumed zero, double-counted components or silently repaired sign.

engineering_acceptance: Closed, separately versioned pilot package using the shared snapshot/reader implementation; original AV objects and manifests unchanged.
At most six selected issuer-periods; exact source tables and excluded extra periods are accounted for.
All collected candidate components, failures and missingness have source receipts; do not suppress an issuer because its supplement failed.
Prove original/derived input immutability, source-byte integrity, normalizer/table pins and actual request accounting.
Return a field-by-issuer-period coverage/conflict matrix and review queue; no candidate is automatically marked verified_exact.
acceptance_and_delivery.research_acceptance: Separate later review of each mapping and method target; this handoff supplies evidence and does not clear the calculator gates.
acceptance_and_delivery.public_delivery: Contract, code and sanitized aggregate counts/statuses only. Keep source payloads, financial values, capture timestamps, private pins/digests, credentials and machine paths in authorized private evidence.
acceptance_and_delivery.failure_is_a_valid_result: Report exact unresolved concept/context/version reasons. A completed bounded collection need not yield any accepted Beneish input or score.
